warn.no_characters: This plan has no character definitions.

motion.summary_partial: Per-shot motion is specified, but the overall motion plan is unspecified.
motion.summary_unspecified: Overall motion and per-shot animation are unspecified.
motion.method_default: Follow the edit engine implementation spec
motion.empty_cues_body: Ask the agent to add motion and entrance, emphasis, exit, and transition-to-next cues will appear here.
motion.title: Motion / animation plan
motion.lede: Align shot motion, target layers, duration, easing, and implementation before the final check.
motion.disclaimer: This motion is an approximation for review. The final picture is reproduced by the selected backend after render and checked at Gate 3.
motion.shot_unspecified: Motion for this shot is unspecified.

analysis.title: Analysis review
analysis.apply_detail: remove {cuts} candidates, shorten by {removed}, output {output}, {captions} captions, {chapters} chapters.
analysis.editorial_lede: Only the stated edit policy is applied after final approval.
analysis.candidate_lede: These are review candidates that keep the source timestamps. Nothing is deleted automatically.
analysis.no_cuts: There are no filler / cut candidates.

composition.title: Composition comparison
composition.missing: Composition proposals are missing or inconsistent. Ask the agent to rebuild them.
composition.select_prompt: Tell the agent to proceed with this proposal to lock the selected composition and rebuild the confirmation page.
composition.selected: Selected proposal {id} is locked as the Gate 1 subject.

shadow.lede: Read-only structure check. It does not change the existing plan, Gate, or render state.
shadow.no_reasons: There are no extra human-judgment reasons.

native.no_code: No code-like inputs were detected. The digest of the whole spec is bound to Gate 1 approval.
native.no_assets: There is no extra local media.
native.binding_item: Resolved at Gate 2 to the matching generated asset ID.
native.title: Native edit spec
native.lede_replace: The native spec defines the entire export. The storyboard is for checking assets and generation requests, not a stand-in timeline.
native.lede_extend: Approved native spec and resources are added to the normal edit.
native.download: Download the full approval payload as JSON

page.no_characters: This plan has no character definitions.
page.reference_images: Reference images that will be sent externally
page.speaker: Speaker
page.no_request: No generation request matches this shot.
page.audio_lede: Confirm BGM and SFX content and timing before final approval. If unresolved, stop. There is no automatic provider fallback.
page.speech_lede: Confirm the text, model, and voice that will be sent. Provider fees cannot be confirmed from estimated generation cost alone.
page.background_lede: The background plate behind people. Confirm the scene mood and aspect before generation.
page.background_caption: This image is used as the stage for the whole exchange.
page.hero_lede: Before generation, review the picture flow, motion, character continuity, and production conditions in order.
page.progress_note: The approval choice appears after every section has been reviewed
page.storyboard_lede: Review composition and tempo from left to right, like joining pieces in time order.
page.characters_lede: Lock expressions and roles before generation.
page.decision_lede: Choose after reviewing composition, motion, characters, generation conditions, sound, and implementation. This HTML is read-only.
page.decision_guide: This page is read-only. You cannot approve from the page. Tell the agent “Approve”, “I want this changed: …”, or “Abort”.
page.commands_summary: Commands for people who want the details
page.h3_lede: Before Gate 1, review the canonical / adapter prompts, validation, and lineage fixed from Creative IR.
page.v2_lede: Lock canonical / adapter, route, profile, grammar, effective contract, and compilation digest as read-only. Secrets, raw provider responses, and absolute paths are not shown.
